```{r required_functions, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE}



read_de_excel <- function(file_path,required_sheets = c("count_data", "sample_information", "comparisons")) {
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    stop("File not found: ", file_path)
  }

  available_sheets <- excel_sheets(file_path)

  missing_sheets <- setdiff(required_sheets, available_sheets)

  if (length(missing_sheets) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The Excel file is missing required sheet(s): ",
      paste(missing_sheets, collapse = ", "),
      "\nSheets found in file: ",
      paste(available_sheets, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # All required sheets present -> read them
  data_list <- list(
    count_data        = read_excel(file_path, sheet = "count_data"),
    sample_info       = read_excel(file_path, sheet = "sample_information"),
    comparisons       = read_excel(file_path, sheet = "comparisons")
  )

  message("All required sheets found and loaded successfully.")
  return(data_list)
}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

## ---- 1. Validate count_data ------------------------------------------------

validate_count_data <- function(count_data) {

  problems <- character(0)

  # Check first column name
  first_col_name <- names(count_data)[1]
  if (!(first_col_name == "Geneid")) {
    problems <- c(problems, paste0("First column should be Geneid"))
  }

  # Check first column values are character and unique
  first_col_vals <- count_data[[1]]
  if (!is.character(first_col_vals)) {
    problems <- c(problems, paste0(
      "First column ('", first_col_name, "') should contain character gene IDs, but is of class: ",class(first_col_vals)[1]
    ))
  }
  if (any(duplicated(first_col_vals))) {
    problems <- c(problems, paste0("First column ('", first_col_name, "') contains duplicate gene IDs: ",sum(duplicated(first_col_vals)), " duplicate(s) found"))
  }

  # Check remaining columns are numeric
  count_cols <- count_data[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  non_numeric_cols <- names(count_cols)[!sapply(count_cols, is.numeric)]
  if (length(non_numeric_cols) > 0) {
    problems <- c(problems, paste0(
      "The following count columns are not numeric: ",
      paste(non_numeric_cols, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  # Check for negative values (counts shouldn't be negative)
  numeric_cols <- count_cols[sapply(count_cols, is.numeric)]
  if (ncol(numeric_cols) > 0) {
    has_negative <- sapply(numeric_cols, function(x) any(x < 0, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (any(has_negative)) {
      problems <- c(problems, paste0(
        "Negative values found in column(s): ",
        paste(names(numeric_cols)[has_negative], collapse = ", ")
      ))
    }
  }
  # Check for missing values
  na_cols <- names(count_data)[sapply(count_data, function(x) any(is.na(x)))]
  if (length(na_cols) > 0) {
    problems <- c(problems, paste0(
      "Missing (NA) values found in column(s): ",
      paste(na_cols, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  if (length(problems) > 0) {
    stop("count_data validation failed:\n- ", paste(problems, collapse = "\n- "))
  }

  message("count_data validated successfully. Gene ID column: '", first_col_name, "'")
  invisible(TRUE)
}


## ---- 2. Validate sample_information ----------------------------------------
validate_sample_info <- function(sample_info,required_cols = c("sample", "condition", "batch", "group"),count_data = NULL) {

  problems <- character(0)

  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(sample_info))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    problems <- c(problems, paste0(
      "Missing required column(s): ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  if ("sample" %in% names(sample_info)) {
    if (any(duplicated(sample_info$sample))) {
      problems <- c(problems, "Duplicate sample names found in 'sample' column")
    }
# Cross-check sample names against count_data column headers, if provided
    if (!is.null(count_data)) {
      count_samples <- names(count_data)[-1]
      missing_in_counts <- setdiff(sample_info$sample, count_samples)
      missing_in_info    <- setdiff(count_samples, sample_info$sample)

      if (length(missing_in_counts) > 0) {
        problems <- c(problems, paste0(
          "Sample(s) in sample_information not found as columns in count_data: ",
          paste(missing_in_counts, collapse = ", ")
        ))
      }
      if (length(missing_in_info) > 0) {
        problems <- c(problems, paste0(
          "Sample column(s) in count_data not found in sample_information: ",
          paste(missing_in_info, collapse = ", ")
        ))
      }
    }
  }
}

## ---- 3. Validate comparisons -------------------------------------------------

validate_comparisons <- function(comparisons,required_cols = c("Comparisons", "Control", "Test"),sample_info = NULL) {

  problems <- character(0)

  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(comparisons))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    problems <- c(problems, paste0(
      "Missing required column(s): ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  if ("Comparisons" %in% names(comparisons)) {
    if (any(duplicated(comparisons$Comparisons))) {
      problems <- c(problems, "Duplicate comparison names found in 'Comparisons' column")
    }
  }
   # Check Control/Test values exist somewhere in sample_information (condition or group)
  if (!is.null(sample_info) && all(c("Control", "Test") %in% names(comparisons))) {
    valid_values <- unique(c(sample_info$condition, sample_info$group))

    bad_control <- setdiff(comparisons$Control, valid_values)
    bad_test    <- setdiff(comparisons$Test, valid_values)

    if (length(bad_control) > 0) {
      problems <- c(problems, paste0(
        "Control value(s) not found in sample_information's condition/group columns: ",
        paste(bad_control, collapse = ", ")
      ))
    }
    if (length(bad_test) > 0) {
      problems <- c(problems, paste0(
        "Test value(s) not found in sample_information's condition/group columns: ",
        paste(bad_test, collapse = ", ")
      ))
    }
  }
if (length(problems) > 0) {
    stop("comparisons validation failed:\n- ", paste(problems, collapse = "\n- "))
  }

  message("comparisons validated successfully.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

## ---- 5. Align count_data column order to sample_information ---------------

align_counts_to_sample_info <- function(count_data, sample_info) {

  gene_id_col <- names(count_data)[1]

  # Set gene IDs as rownames, keep only count columns
  counts_mat <- count_data %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = gene_id_col) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  # Reorder/subset columns to match sample_info$sample exactly
  missing_samples <- setdiff(sample_info$sample, colnames(counts_mat))
  if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
    stop("Sample(s) in sample_information not found in count_data: ",
         paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", "))
  }

  counts_mat <- counts_mat[, sample_info$sample, drop = FALSE]

  # Sanity check: order now matches exactly
  if (!identical(colnames(counts_mat), sample_info$sample)) {
    stop("Column ordering could not be aligned to sample_information$sample")
  }
  

  message("count_data aligned to sample_information (", ncol(counts_mat), " samples, ",
          nrow(counts_mat), " genes).")

  return(counts_mat)
}

## ---- 6. Wrapper: read + validate everything ---------------------------------

read_and_validate_de_excel <- function(file_path) {

  # (reuses read_de_excel from before to check sheets exist + read them)
  de_data <- read_de_excel(file_path)

  validate_count_data(de_data$count_data)
  validate_sample_info(de_data$sample_info, count_data = de_data$count_data)
  validate_comparisons(de_data$comparisons, sample_info = de_data$sample_info)

  message("All tabs validated successfully.")
  return(de_data)
}


## ---- 5. Run DE analysis for every row in the comparisons tab --------------
run_de_for_comparisons_deseq <- function(counts_mat, sample_info, comparisons,group_col = "condition",
                                    alpha = 0.05,log2fc_cutoff = 1,gene_info = NULL,gene_info_id_col = "gene_id",correct_batch = FALSE,group_size = 3) {

  if (!(group_col %in% names(sample_info))) {
    stop("group_col '", group_col, "' not found in sample_information. ",
         "Available columns: ", paste(names(sample_info), collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Validate gene_info up front, if provided
  if (!is.null(gene_info)) {
    if (!(gene_info_id_col %in% names(gene_info))) {
      stop("gene_info_id_col '", gene_info_id_col, "' not found in gene_info. ",
           "Available columns: ", paste(names(gene_info), collapse = ", "))
    }
    if (any(duplicated(gene_info[[gene_info_id_col]]))) {
      warning("gene_info contains duplicate '", gene_info_id_col,
              "' values — merge may produce duplicate rows in results.")
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.numeric(group_size) ||
      length(group_size) != 1 || is.na(group_size) ||group_size < 1) {
    stop("'group_size' must be a single positive integer.")
  }
  

  group_size <- as.integer(group_size)
  
   if (!is.logical(correct_batch) || length(correct_batch) != 1) {
    stop("'correct_batch' must be TRUE or FALSE.")
   }
  
  if (correct_batch && !("batch" %in% names(sample_info))) {
    stop(
      "correct_batch = TRUE, but 'batch' column was not found in sample_info."
    )
  }

  results_list <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(comparisons))) {

    comp_name <- comparisons$Comparisons[i]
    ctrl_grp  <- comparisons$Control[i]
    test_grp  <- comparisons$Test[i]

    message("\nRunning comparison: ", comp_name,
            " (Test = ", test_grp, " vs Control = ", ctrl_grp, ")")

    # Subset sample_info to just the two groups in this comparison
    sub_info <- sample_info %>%
      filter(.data[[group_col]] %in% c(ctrl_grp, test_grp))

    if (nrow(sub_info) == 0) {
      warning("No matching samples found for comparison '", comp_name,
               "' — skipping.")
      next
    }

    missing_grp <- setdiff(c(ctrl_grp, test_grp), unique(sub_info[[group_col]]))
    if (length(missing_grp) > 0) {
      warning("Comparison '", comp_name, "' — group(s) not found in sample_information: ",
               paste(missing_grp, collapse = ", "), " — skipping.")
      next
    }

    # Subset & align counts to just these samples, in sub_info's order
    sub_counts <- counts_mat[, sub_info$sample, drop = FALSE]
    
    print(sub_counts)

    # Set factor levels explicitly so Test is compared vs Control (reference)
    sub_info[[group_col]] <- factor(sub_info[[group_col]], levels = c(ctrl_grp, test_grp))
    print(sub_info[[group_col]])
    # Build design formula — adjust for batch if present and has >1 level
    if ("batch" %in% names(sub_info) && length(unique(sub_info$batch)) > 1) {
      design_formula <- as.formula(paste("~ batch +", group_col))
    } else {
      design_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", group_col))
    }

     dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
       countData = round(sub_counts),   # DESeq2 requires integer counts
       colData   = sub_info,
       design    = design_formula
     )
   
     # Remove genes with all-zero counts across these samples
     keep <- rowSums(sub_counts > 10) >= group_size
     
     dds <- dds[keep,]

   
     dds <- DESeq(dds)

   
     res <- results(dds,
                     contrast = c(group_col, test_grp, ctrl_grp),
                     alpha = alpha)

    res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "Geneid") %>%
      arrange(padj)

    # ---- Add up/down/not-significant annotation ----
    res_df <- res_df %>%
      mutate(
        regulation = case_when(
          is.na(padj)                                     ~ "Not significant",
          padj < alpha & log2FoldChange >=  log2fc_cutoff  ~ "Upregulated",
          padj < alpha & log2FoldChange <= -log2fc_cutoff  ~ "Downregulated",
          TRUE                                             ~ "Not significant"
        )
      )

    # ---- Merge in gene annotation info, if provided ----
    if (!is.null(gene_info)) {
      n_before <- nrow(res_df)

      res_df <- res_df %>%
        left_join(gene_info, by = c("Geneid" = gene_info_id_col)) %>%
        relocate(any_of(setdiff(names(gene_info), gene_info_id_col)), .after = Geneid)

      n_unmatched <- sum(!res_df$Geneid %in% gene_info[[gene_info_id_col]])
      if (n_unmatched > 0) {
        message("  Note: ", n_unmatched, " gene(s) had no match in gene_info")
      }
      if (nrow(res_df) != n_before) {
        warning("Comparison '", comp_name,
                "': row count changed after merging gene_info (check for duplicate IDs).")
      }
    }

    results_list[[comp_name]] <- list(
      dds     = dds,
      results = res_df
    )

    n_up   <- sum(res_df$regulation == "Upregulated")
    n_down <- sum(res_df$regulation == "Downregulated")

    message("  -> ", n_up, " upregulated, ", n_down, " downregulated ",
            "(padj < ", alpha, ", |log2FC| >= ", log2fc_cutoff, ")")
  }

  return(results_list)
}

## ---- 6. Run DE analysis using edgeR --------------

run_de_for_comparisons_edgeR <- function(counts_mat, sample_info, comparisons,
                                          group_col = "condition",
                                          alpha = 0.05,
                                          log2fc_cutoff = 1,
                                          gene_info = NULL,
                                          gene_info_id_col = "gene_id",
                                          test_method = c("qlf", "lrt", "exact")) {

  test_method <- match.arg(test_method)

  if (!(group_col %in% names(sample_info))) {
    stop("group_col '", group_col, "' not found in sample_information. ",
         "Available columns: ", paste(names(sample_info), collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Validate gene_info up front, if provided
  if (!is.null(gene_info)) {
    if (!(gene_info_id_col %in% names(gene_info))) {
      stop("gene_info_id_col '", gene_info_id_col, "' not found in gene_info. ",
           "Available columns: ", paste(names(gene_info), collapse = ", "))
    }
    if (any(duplicated(gene_info[[gene_info_id_col]]))) {
      warning("gene_info contains duplicate '", gene_info_id_col,
              "' values — merge may produce duplicate rows in results.")
    }
  }

  results_list <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(comparisons))) {

    comp_name <- comparisons$Comparisons[i]
    ctrl_grp  <- comparisons$Control[i]
    test_grp  <- comparisons$Test[i]

    message("\nRunning comparison: ", comp_name,
            " (Test = ", test_grp, " vs Control = ", ctrl_grp, ")")

    # Subset sample_info to just the two groups in this comparison
    sub_info <- sample_info %>%
      filter(.data[[group_col]] %in% c(ctrl_grp, test_grp))

    if (nrow(sub_info) == 0) {
      warning("No matching samples found for comparison '", comp_name,
               "' — skipping.")
      next
    }

    missing_grp <- setdiff(c(ctrl_grp, test_grp), unique(sub_info[[group_col]]))
    if (length(missing_grp) > 0) {
      warning("Comparison '", comp_name, "' — group(s) not found in sample_information: ",
               paste(missing_grp, collapse = ", "), " — skipping.")
      next
    }

    # Subset & align counts to just these samples, in sub_info's order
    sub_counts <- counts_mat[, sub_info$sample, drop = FALSE]

    # Set factor levels explicitly so Test is compared vs Control (reference)
    group_factor <- factor(sub_info[[group_col]], levels = c(ctrl_grp, test_grp))

    # Build design formula — adjust for batch if present and has >1 level
    use_batch <- "batch" %in% names(sub_info) && length(unique(sub_info$batch)) > 1

    if (use_batch && test_method == "exact") {
      warning("Comparison '", comp_name,
              "': batch correction requested but not supported by exact test — ",
              "switching to QLF for this comparison.")
      this_method <- "qlf"
    } else {
      this_method <- test_method
    }

    # ---- Build DGEList ----
    dge <- DGEList(counts = round(sub_counts), group = group_factor)

    # Filter low-count genes (standard edgeR practice)
    keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = group_factor)
    dge  <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

    # Normalize (TMM)
    dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

    if (this_method == "exact") {
      # Classic exact test — simplest, no design matrix / batch support
      dge <- estimateDisp(dge)
      et  <- exactTest(dge, pair = c(ctrl_grp, test_grp))
      tt  <- topTags(et, n = Inf, sort.by = "PValue")$table

    } else {
      # QLF or LRT — supports batch correction via design matrix
      if (use_batch) {
        batch_factor  <- factor(sub_info$batch)
        design_matrix <- model.matrix(~ batch_factor + group_factor)
      } else {
        design_matrix <- model.matrix(~ group_factor)
      }

      dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design = design_matrix)
      coef_name <- tail(colnames(design_matrix), 1)  # last coef = test vs control

      if (this_method == "qlf") {
        fit <- glmQLFit(dge, design_matrix)
        qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = coef_name)
        tt  <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf, sort.by = "PValue")$table
      } else {  # lrt
        fit <- glmFit(dge, design_matrix)
        lrt <- glmLRT(fit, coef = coef_name)
        tt  <- topTags(lrt, n = Inf, sort.by = "PValue")$table
      }
    }

    res_df <- tt %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "Geneid") %>%
      rename(
        log2FoldChange = logFC,
        pvalue         = PValue,
        padj           = FDR
      ) %>%
      arrange(padj)

    # ---- Add up/down/not-significant annotation ----
    res_df <- res_df %>%
      mutate(
        regulation = case_when(
          is.na(padj)                                     ~ "Not significant",
          padj < alpha & log2FoldChange >=  log2fc_cutoff  ~ "Upregulated",
          padj < alpha & log2FoldChange <= -log2fc_cutoff  ~ "Downregulated",
          TRUE                                             ~ "Not significant"
        )
      )

    # ---- Merge in gene annotation info, if provided ----
    if (!is.null(gene_info)) {
      n_before <- nrow(res_df)

      res_df <- res_df %>%
        left_join(gene_info, by = c("Geneid" = gene_info_id_col)) %>%
        relocate(any_of(setdiff(names(gene_info), gene_info_id_col)), .after = Geneid)

      n_unmatched <- sum(!res_df$Geneid %in% gene_info[[gene_info_id_col]])
      if (n_unmatched > 0) {
        message("  Note: ", n_unmatched, " gene(s) had no match in gene_info")
      }
      if (nrow(res_df) != n_before) {
        warning("Comparison '", comp_name,
                "': row count changed after merging gene_info (check for duplicate IDs).")
      }
    }

    results_list[[comp_name]] <- list(
      dge     = dge,
      results = res_df
    )

    n_up   <- sum(res_df$regulation == "Upregulated")
    n_down <- sum(res_df$regulation == "Downregulated")

    message("  -> ", n_up, " upregulated, ", n_down, " downregulated ",
            "(padj < ", alpha, ", |log2FC| >= ", log2fc_cutoff, ", method = ", this_method, ")")
  }

  return(results_list)
}



##GSEA analysis
## ---- Helper: resolve organism -> org_db + KEGG code ------------------------

get_organism_resources <- function(organism = c("mouse", "human")) {

  organism <- match.arg(organism)

  if (organism == "mouse") {
    list(org_db = org.Mm.eg.db, kegg_code = "mmu")
  } else if (organism == "human") {
    list(org_db = org.Hs.eg.db, kegg_code = "hsa")
  }
}

## ---- 1. Prepare a ranked gene list from DE results -------------------------

prepare_ranked_genes <- function(DE_df, gene_col, pval_col, logfc_col,
                                  seed = 123, perturb_range = 1e-6) {

  # Basic sanity checks
  if (!all(c(gene_col, pval_col, logfc_col) %in% colnames(DE_df))) {
    stop("One or more specified columns not found in DE_df.")
  }

  genes    <- DE_df[[gene_col]]
  adj_pval <- DE_df[[pval_col]]
  logFC    <- DE_df[[logfc_col]]

  # Report NA breakdown before dropping anything (helps diagnose data issues)
  n_na_gene  <- sum(is.na(genes) | genes == "")
  n_na_pval  <- sum(is.na(adj_pval))
  n_na_logfc <- sum(is.na(logFC))
  if (n_na_gene + n_na_pval + n_na_logfc > 0) {
    message("Dropping rows with missing values — gene: ", n_na_gene,
            ", p-value: ", n_na_pval, ", log2FC: ", n_na_logfc)
  }

  keep <- !is.na(genes) & genes != "" & !is.na(adj_pval) & !is.na(logFC)
  genes    <- genes[keep]
  adj_pval <- adj_pval[keep]
  logFC    <- logFC[keep]

  # Floor zero p-values to smallest representable double, so -log10() never hits Inf
  n_zero <- sum(adj_pval == 0)
  if (n_zero > 0) {
    warning(n_zero, " p-value(s) exactly 0 — flooring to machine epsilon (",
            .Machine$double.xmin, ") before ranking, to avoid Inf/-Inf.")
    adj_pval[adj_pval == 0] <- .Machine$double.xmin
  }

  # Compute ranking metric: -log10(p) signed by direction of fold change
  rank_metric <- -log10(adj_pval) * sign(logFC)

  # Add tiny random perturbation to break ties (e.g., many genes with p = 1 or identical stats)
  set.seed(seed)
  perturbation <- runif(length(rank_metric), min = -perturb_range, max = perturb_range)
  rank_metric_perturbed <- rank_metric + perturbation

  # Handle duplicate gene IDs — keep the one with the strongest |rank_metric|
  n_dup <- sum(duplicated(genes))
  if (n_dup > 0) {
    message(n_dup, " duplicate gene ID(s) found — keeping the entry with the strongest ",
            "rank metric per ID.")
    dup_df <- data.frame(genes = genes, rank_metric_perturbed = rank_metric_perturbed) %>%
      group_by(genes) %>%
      slice_max(order_by = abs(rank_metric_perturbed), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup()
    genes                 <- dup_df$genes
    rank_metric_perturbed <- dup_df$rank_metric_perturbed
  }

  # Build named, sorted vector for GSEA (fgsea, clusterProfiler, etc.)
  ranked_genes <- sort(setNames(rank_metric_perturbed, genes), decreasing = TRUE)

  return(ranked_genes)
}

## ---- 2. GSEA for a single GO ontology (BP / MF / CC) -----------------------

run_gsea_go <- function(gene_list,
                         ontology = c("BP", "MF", "CC"),
                         organism = c("mouse", "human"),
                         pvalue_cutoff = 0.05,
                         seed = 42) {

  ontology <- match.arg(ontology)
  organism <- match.arg(organism)
  org_db   <- get_organism_resources(organism)$org_db

  set.seed(seed)
  gsea_res <- gseGO(
    geneList      = gene_list,
    OrgDb         = org_db,
    ont           = ontology,
    keyType       = "ENTREZID",
    minGSSize     = 10,
    maxGSSize     = 500,
    pvalueCutoff  = pvalue_cutoff,
    verbose       = FALSE,
    seed          = TRUE
  )

  res_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_res) %>% arrange(p.adjust)
  message("GO-", ontology, ": ", nrow(res_df), " significant terms at padj < ", pvalue_cutoff)

  return(list(gsea_obj = gsea_res, results = res_df))
}

## ---- 3. GSEA for KEGG pathways ----------------------------------------------

run_gsea_kegg <- function(gene_list,
                           organism = c("mouse", "human"),
                           pvalue_cutoff = 0.05,
                           seed = 42) {

  organism  <- match.arg(organism)
  kegg_code <- get_organism_resources(organism)$kegg_code

  set.seed(seed)
  gsea_res <- gseKEGG(
    geneList      = gene_list,
    organism      = kegg_code,
    keyType       = "ncbi-geneid",
    minGSSize     = 10,
    maxGSSize     = 500,
    pvalueCutoff  = pvalue_cutoff,
    verbose       = FALSE,
    seed          = TRUE
  )

  res_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_res) %>% arrange(p.adjust)
  message("KEGG: ", nrow(res_df), " significant pathways at padj < ", pvalue_cutoff)

  return(list(gsea_obj = gsea_res, results = res_df))
}

## ---- 4. Wrapper: run all four GSEA analyses for every comparison -----------
## ---- ID mapping helper (Ensembl -> Entrez), separate from ranking ----------

map_ensembl_to_entrez <- function(res_df, id_col = "Geneid", organism = c("mouse", "human")) {

  organism <- match.arg(organism)
  org_db   <- get_organism_resources(organism)$org_db

  res_df <- res_df %>%
    mutate(ensembl_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", .data[[id_col]]))

  id_map <- bitr(res_df$ensembl_clean,
                  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
                  toType   = "ENTREZID",
                  OrgDb    = org_db)

  n_mapped <- nrow(id_map)
  n_total  <- length(unique(res_df$ensembl_clean))
  message("Mapped ", n_mapped, " / ", n_total, " gene IDs to Entrez (",
          round(100 * n_mapped / n_total, 1), "%) [organism = ", organism, "]")

  res_mapped <- res_df %>%
    inner_join(id_map, by = c("ensembl_clean" = "ENSEMBL"))

  return(res_mapped)
}


## ---- Updated wrapper --------------------------------------------------------

run_gsea_for_all_comparisons <- function(de_results,
                                          gene_col  = "Geneid",
                                          pval_col  = "pvalue",
                                          logfc_col = "log2FoldChange",
                                          organism = c("mouse", "human"),
                                          pvalue_cutoff = 0.05,
                                          seed = 123,
                                          perturb_range = 1e-6) {

  organism <- match.arg(organism)
  gsea_results <- list()

  for (comp_name in names(de_results)) {

    message("\n=== GSEA for comparison: ", comp_name, " ===")

    res_df <- de_results[[comp_name]]$results

    # Step 1: map gene IDs to Entrez
    res_mapped <- map_ensembl_to_entrez(
      res_df   = res_df,
      id_col   = gene_col,
      organism = organism
    )

    # Step 2: build ranked gene list from mapped data
    gene_list <- prepare_ranked_genes(
      DE_df         = res_mapped,
      gene_col      = "ENTREZID",
      pval_col      = pval_col,
      logfc_col     = logfc_col,
      seed          = seed,
      perturb_range = perturb_range
    )

    if (length(gene_list) < 10) {
      warning("Comparison '", comp_name, "': too few mapped genes (",
              length(gene_list), ") — skipping GSEA.")
      next
    }

    gsea_results[[comp_name]] <- list(
      BP   = run_gsea_go(gene_list, ontology = "BP", organism = organism, pvalue_cutoff = pvalue_cutoff),
      MF   = run_gsea_go(gene_list, ontology = "MF", organism = organism, pvalue_cutoff = pvalue_cutoff),
      CC   = run_gsea_go(gene_list, ontology = "CC", organism = organism, pvalue_cutoff = pvalue_cutoff),
      KEGG = run_gsea_kegg(gene_list, organism = organism, pvalue_cutoff = pvalue_cutoff)
    )
  }

  return(gsea_results)
}

## ---- . Write results -----------

write_de_and_gsea_to_excel <- function(de_results,
                                        gsea_results = NULL,
                                        output_dir,
                                        prefix = "Results_",
                                        include_summary_sheet = TRUE) {

  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message("Created output directory: ", output_dir)
  }

  for (comp_name in names(de_results)) {

    res_df <- de_results[[comp_name]]$results

    if (is.null(res_df) || nrow(res_df) == 0) {
      warning("Comparison '", comp_name, "' has no DE results — skipping file.")
      next
    }

    safe_name <- gsub("[/\\\\:*?\"<>|]", "_", comp_name)
    file_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, safe_name, ".xlsx"))

    wb <- createWorkbook()

    ## ---------------- DE results sheet ----------------
    addWorksheet(wb, "DE_results")
    writeData(wb, "DE_results", res_df, withFilter = TRUE)
    freezePane(wb, "DE_results", firstRow = TRUE)
    setColWidths(wb, "DE_results", cols = seq_len(ncol(res_df)),
                 widths = pmin(pmax(nchar(names(res_df)) + 2, 10), 40))

    ## ---------------- Summary sheet ----------------
    if (include_summary_sheet) {
      n_up   <- if ("regulation" %in% names(res_df)) sum(res_df$regulation == "Upregulated", na.rm = TRUE) else NA
      n_down <- if ("regulation" %in% names(res_df)) sum(res_df$regulation == "Downregulated", na.rm = TRUE) else NA
      n_ns   <- if ("regulation" %in% names(res_df)) sum(res_df$regulation == "Not significant", na.rm = TRUE) else NA

      has_gsea <- !is.null(gsea_results) && comp_name %in% names(gsea_results)

      summary_df <- data.frame(
        Metric = c("Comparison", "Total genes tested", "Upregulated", "Downregulated",
                   "Not significant", "GSEA included"),
        Value  = c(comp_name, nrow(res_df), n_up, n_down, n_ns, ifelse(has_gsea, "Yes", "No"))
      )

      if (has_gsea) {
        gsea_comp <- gsea_results[[comp_name]]
        for (ont in c("BP", "MF", "CC", "KEGG")) {
          n_sig <- if (!is.null(gsea_comp[[ont]])) nrow(gsea_comp[[ont]]$results) else NA
          summary_df <- rbind(summary_df,
                               data.frame(Metric = paste0(ont, " significant terms"), Value = n_sig))
        }
      }

      addWorksheet(wb, "Summary")
      writeData(wb, "Summary", summary_df, colNames = TRUE)
      setColWidths(wb, "Summary", cols = 1:2, widths = c(25, 30))
    }
## ---------------- GSEA sheets (BP, MF, CC, KEGG) ----------------
    if (!is.null(gsea_results) && comp_name %in% names(gsea_results)) {

      gsea_comp <- gsea_results[[comp_name]]
      sheet_map <- c(BP = "GO_BP", MF = "GO_MF", CC = "GO_CC", KEGG = "KEGG")

      for (ont in names(sheet_map)) {

        sheet_name <- sheet_map[[ont]]
        gsea_df <- gsea_comp[[ont]]$results

        addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)

        if (is.null(gsea_df) || nrow(gsea_df) == 0) {
          writeData(wb, sheet_name, data.frame(Message = paste0("No significant ", ont, " terms found")))
          next
        }
writeData(wb, sheet_name, gsea_df, withFilter = TRUE)
        freezePane(wb, sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
        setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(gsea_df)),
                     widths = pmin(pmax(nchar(names(gsea_df)) + 2, 10), 50))
      }

    } else if (!is.null(gsea_results)) {
      message("Comparison '", comp_name, "' has no GSEA results — DE-only file written.")
    }

    saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
    message("Saved: ", file_path)
  }

  message("\nAll comparison(s) written to: ", output_dir)
  invisible(NULL)
}
```
